caption: The drawing features a highly ornate metal object, likely a fireplace andiron, depicted in grayscale on a plain, off-white background. The andiron stands upright, with a base consisting of two feet that curve outward in scroll-like shapes. The vertical section rising from the base is lavishly decorated with intricate curvilinear forms, acanthus leaves, and floral elements. Several small sculpted animal or human heads protrude from the sides of the upper portion. The central panel of the vertical section contains an oval medallion with detailed embellishments. Extending backward from the base is a straight horizontal bar, which is less ornamented and appears functional. The entire object is rendered with detailed shading, emphasizing its three-dimensional form and elaborate decorative features.
title: Andiron (one of pair)
